background.$description: Default page background color for the primary content surface

ghost.$description: Fill color for ghost-style interactive elements such as buttons that have the same color as the background in their default state

branded.$description: Fill color for branded ghost-style interactive elements that match the background in their default state

constructive.$description: Fill color for constructive ghost-style interactive elements that match the background in their default state

destructive.$description: Fill color for destructive ghost-style interactive elements that match the background in their default state

input.$description: Fill color for input elements such as text fields, textareas, and select dropdowns

error.$description: Fill color for input elements in an error validation state

success.$description: Fill color for input elements in a success validation state

warning.$description: Fill color for input elements in a warning validation state

primary.$description: Fill color for primary navigation elements such as the main navigation bar

checkmark.$description: Fill color for the checkmark icon inside checkbox components

unselected.$description: Fill color for the checkbox container when unselected

checkmark.$description: Fill color for the indicator dot inside radio button components

unselected.$description: Fill color for the radio button container when unselected

knob.$description: Fill color for the knob of switch toggle components
